title: Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.28349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Under structured outputs (JSON schemas, regexes, tool calls), speculative drafters do not see the grammar constraint and repeatedly propose invalid keys, delimiters, and indentation, while the grammar engine already knows which tokens must come next.   We present Grammar-as-a-Draft (GaaD), which treats the grammar as a second drafter. Before each verify step, the scheduler merges the drafter's proposal with grammar-forced tokens into one draft row: matching tokens stay as GRAMMAR, the proposal is cut where it leaves the forced path, and forced tokens fill the rest of a row wider than the drafter's proposal. The verify step accepts GRAMMAR drafts without computing their logits, composing with any drafter with no new kernels or compilation on the critical path. Because grammars fix text rather than tokens, committing canonical forced tokens changes the output distribution relative to grammar-masked target decoding.   We implement GaaD in

translated_title: Grammar-as-a-Draft（语法即草稿）：在语法约束的结构化输出中让每次推测解码步产生更多Token
translated_abstract: 在结构化输出（JSON模式、正则表达式、工具调用）场景下，推测式草稿模型无法感知语法约束，会反复提议无效的键名、分隔符和缩进，而语法引擎其实早已知道接下来必须出现的Token。我们提出了Grammar-as-a-Draft（GaaD），它将语法视为第二个草稿模型。在每次验证步骤之前，调度器将草稿模型的提议与语法强制Token合并为一行草稿：匹配的Token保留为GRAMMAR状态，在提议偏离强制路径之处将其截断，并由强制Token填满比草稿提议更宽的行的剩余部分。验证步骤无需计算GRAMMAR草稿的logits即可接受它们，可与任何草稿模型组合，且在关键路径上无需新增内核或编译。由于语法固定的是文本而非Token，提交规范的强制Token相对于使用语法掩码的目标解码会改变输出分布。
tldr: 该论文提出Grammar-as-a-Draft（GaaD），将语法引擎作为第二草稿模型，把语法强制Token与推测草稿模型的提议合并为更宽的草稿行，使语法约束的结构化输出下每次推测解码步可验证更多Token，且无需新增内核或编译。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Grammar-as-a-Draft (GaaD), which treats the grammar engine as a second drafter and merges grammar-forced tokens with the drafter's proposal into wider draft rows, enabling more verified tokens per speculative decoding step for grammar-constrained structured outputs without new kernels or compilation.
